d: Mokama ke vidhayak Anant Singh ki beti Shivangi Singh ki shadi ki rasmon ke bich haldi samaroh ki tasviren aur vidiyo samne aae hain. haldi ke mauke par Shivangi Peach rang ke lahange men najar aaeen, vahin parivar ke sadasy pile kapron men dikhaee die. man Neelam Devi aur bhaee-bahnon ne paranprik rasmon ke dauran Shivangi ko haldi lagaee. parivar ke in khas palon ki tasviren soshal midiya par vayral ho rahi hain.
